title: Node suite red at epic head: dumb-git-origin test lacks 300s timeout
body:
harness/test/node/harness-timeout-discipline.test.ts fails on the branch base (reproduced at 9bb160307948 in a scratch worktree): node/dumb-git-origin.test.ts's test 'an origin that outlives the box carries the boot, the wip and the restore' declares no >= 300_000 ms timeout. Introduced by tick a2l's merge into epic/43y (4fdb71505). Not caused by this tick's diff; a red harness node suite is what the epic close-out's CI can surface.
evidence: cd harness && pnpm vitest run -c vitest.node.config.ts → harness-timeout-discipline.test.ts 'declares a timeout of at least 300_000 ms on every process-driving test': expected [] to deeply equal [ 'node/dumb-git-origin.test.ts: an origin that outlives the box carries the boot, the wip and the restore' ]
demonstrating_check: cd harness && pnpm vitest run -c vitest.node.config.ts
